title: 史上最大基建开建：百万岗位同步落地，安全标准还没定？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Whoever wins AI wins, I think that's very important, but I think the technology has very real risks.
segments.zh: 谁赢得AI谁就赢，这很重要，但技术有切实风险。

segments.en: And, you know, the mechanism how we address those risks is still under discussion.
segments.zh: 应对这些风险的机制仍在讨论中。

segments.en: But we all need to work, we all need to work together to make sure that we can win and we can win safely.
segments.zh: 但我们需要共同努力，确保能赢，也能安全地赢。

segments.en: If we do this right, we work with the president and everyone here, we can win safely.
segments.zh: 如果做对了，与总统和各位合作，我们就能安全取胜。

segments.en: This is the largest industrial revolution in history. And we're going through the single largest infrastructure buildout in the human history order.
segments.zh: 这是史上最大工业革命，我们正经历人类史上最大基建。

segments.en: And so it's creating a million jobs here in the United States.
segments.zh: 这在美国创造了百万就业岗位。

segments.en: We have chip plants coming up, computer plants coming up, the factories coming up.
segments.zh: 芯片厂、电脑厂、工厂都在建设中。

segments.en: And so it's creating just a normal amount of jobs. The basic idea is that we want to give the American people and our customers confidence
segments.zh: 这创造了正常数量的就业。基本想法是让美国人民和客户相信

segments.en: that the technology works in the way that we intend, right?
segments.zh: 技术按我们预期的方式运行，对吧？

segments.en: So every company is building something that's a little bit different, you know, having one set of standards for what is, what everyone should want to build.
segments.zh: 每家公司都在建略有不同的东西，需要一套标准来定义大家该建什么。

segments.en: We don't want to do some different things. But I think what we can all agree on is that the American public and our customers want to know that what we're building is working in the way that we all intend.
segments.zh: 我们不想做不同的事。但我想大家都能同意，美国公众和我们的客户想知道，我们构建的东西正按我们所有人的意图运行。

segments.en: Jobs are going to change. Jobs have always changed.
segments.zh: 工作会变化。工作一直在变化。

segments.en: But it could be a computer, it used to be a job, it used to be buildings filled with people doing calculations.
segments.zh: 但可能是计算机，过去是工作，过去是满是做计算的人的建筑物。

segments.en: But now, you have digital computers to do those tasks.
segments.zh: 但现在，你有数字计算机来完成这些任务。

segments.en: I don't think anyone is pining to go back and do calculations all day to do bank interest rates, which is what they used to do.
segments.zh: 我不认为有人渴望回到过去整天做计算来算银行利率，那是他们过去做的。
